DADAAD · Research internship Open

DAAD WISE 2027 (Germany)

Funded 2–3 month summer research internship at a German university or institute for Indian undergraduates (May–July 2027).

STIPEND / MONTH
Paid · amount TBC
Stipend details
Monthly DAAD stipend plus travel allowance (reported figures vary, roughly €750–€861 per month).
Entry deadline
1 Nov 2026 (exact cutoff time not announced)
Format & location
In person · Germany
Who can apply
Indian nationals in science, engineering or maths at a DAAD WISE partner institution in India; a signed invitation letter from a German professor is needed.
Accommodation & support
Travel allowance and insurance reported · stipend covers living costs

Entry notes

  • Deadline conflicts across sources (1 Nov vs late Nov); confirm on daad.in. The DAAD portal opens about 6 weeks before the deadline.
  • Students at non-partner institutions are not eligible.
